site_name: Millgate Shopping Centre and Land at Clerke St, Bury
evidence_slice: Bury Council's 2024 Strategic Housing Land Availability Assessment summary identifies HL/3180/00, Millgate Shopping Centre and Land at Clerke St, Bury, as an East Bury site with 6.051 hectares, anticipated density 114, anticipated capacity 700 and 0-5 year availability. The detailed Category 4 site listing identifies the same SHLAA reference at Millgate Shopping Centre with no current planning status, capacity 670, 5.8797 hectares, previously developed land, and suitable, available, achievable and deliverable status; it records a first phase of about 120 units within five years through Bury town-centre regeneration. The 2024 five-year supply statement likewise records 120 units from HL/3180/00 within the five-year supply.
